notes: Evolution Kart School and The Kart Depot are legally separate businesses under the same owner, sharing this app's shell and Trackside Navy/Blue/Yellow brand palette. Evolution's workspace reads blue (navy ground, blue accent); The Kart Depot's reads yellow (amber ground, yellow accent) — see style.css's body[data-entity] block. Billing remains scoped by entity so the two sets of books never blend.

entities.name: Evolution Kart School
entities.role: Driver coaching, race-weekend operations and mechanic training.

entities.name: The Kart Depot
entities.role: Kart, parts and equipment retail; workshop supply.
